title: Bound mixed-edit alignments with concrete C=7 existence and explicit enumeration costs
statement: For1<=t<=n/4, M=sum_(d=0..t,s=0..min(n-d,2t-2d)) binom(n,d)^2*2^d*binom(n-d,s). For l=2d+s>=1, each summand is <=2^d n^l/(d!^2 s!)<=(6en/l)^l, using l!/(d!d!s!)<=3^l and l!>=(l/e)^l. The expression increases for l<=2t, and there are at most(2t+1)^2 terms. Hence log2 M<=2t log2(n/t)+2t log2(3e)+2log2(2t+1)<=2t log2(n/t)+12t+4. Identity, fixed-point and duplicate affine maps only overcount. This supplies uniform GV-scale size/existence, not a polynomial-n uniform construction or decoder for growing t. P2 58FB sharpens this to M<=sum_(q<=2t)[(1+2sqrt(2))*n]^q/q!<=(10n/t)^(2t), using increasing terms, (2t)!>=(2t/e)^(2t), 2t+1<=3^t. Therefore b=ceil(log2(2M)) gives redundancy<=2t log2(n/t)+7t+3; if b>=n the zero-message code suffices under C=7. However M>=2^t*binom(n,t)^2>=2^t(n/t)^(2t), superpolynomial at t=floor(log2 n); even y=0^n has binom(n,t) t-substitution candidates. These lower bounds concern explicit enumeration, not all algorithms.
